description: United States address-validation leg (U.S. Census Bureau Census Geocoder) at $0.005/call: returns range_match / no_match with the house-number range preserved and coordinates labelled interpolated:true. A range match is not an existence verdict. address.state is required. Free pre-check: POST /toll/address/legs/us/validate/preflight. $0.005 per call — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: POST https://exchangerebel.com/toll/address/legs/us/validate.

address.description: Structured address components: street_number, street_name, locality, state, postcode required; unit, street_type optional.

name: address_leg_us
